metadata.remarks: Generated by grundschutz-worksheets tools/id-catalog.mjs. Do not edit by hand. The Trust Services Criteria are copyright of the AICPA and are not reproduced here. This catalog holds only their IDs, to point at; the titles of categories, series and criteria are this repository's own short labels, not the AICPA's wording, and say no more than what a criterion is about. A SOC 2 report is the opinion of a CPA firm on a description of a system against these criteria; nothing here is one.
